description: This file defines a migration class for version 4.8.0 of the OrangeHRM system, responsible for inserting configuration values and internationalization groups in a database schema during migration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class that performs database migration tasks for version 4.8.0 of OrangeHRM, including inserting configuration and internationalization group data.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Defines the migration steps to insert help URL, help processor class, and help internationalization group into the database.

methods.name: insertConfig
methods.description: Inserts a configuration key-value pair into the 'hs_hr_config' table.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.8' indicating the migration's target version.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Updates a configuration value in the 'hs_hr_config' table for a given key. (Note: not invoked in the main code flow).
